purpose: Answer exactly one design question with a running answer: can a Cloudflare Worker connect to a real VPS over SSH and read a file's bytes? The main feature (vps-file-hub) cannot proceed to spec until this is resolved, because its whole collection channel depends on it.
question: Can a Worker, using a Workers-native SSH stack over cloudflare:sockets, complete TCP connect + SSH authentication + SFTP directory listing + SFTP file read against a real remote VPS, within the paid-plan CPU budget?
requirements: Runs on a real deployed Worker against a real remote VPS; local wrangler dev cannot be used because outbound connections to localhost and private IPs are refused.
Uses a Workers-native pure-TS SSH stack; ssh2 is excluded because runtime WASM compilation is disallowed in workerd and the upstream issue is open with the maintainer declining support.
Negotiates AES-GCM (WebCrypto-backed) rather than pure-JS ChaCha20-Poly1305, because CPU is the binding constraint.
Proves the chain end to end: directory listing, then reading one file and verifying its content by hash.
Reports measured CPU time and wall time from the invocation log so the paid-plan budget can be judged.
Performs read-only operations on the target host.
constraints: Never merged to main; kept as a primary source on branch prototype/ssh-probe (flow manual section 2.3).
Disposable by design: the write-up is optimised for speed of learning, not for production quality.
Read-only on the target VPS: no writes, deletes, or modifications.
Credentials must never be committed; they are supplied via wrangler secret or a local untracked file.
Deploying the probe creates a real but throwaway Worker; that deployment is part of the experiment.
acceptance: PASS: SFTP list returns real directory entries AND a read file's SHA-256 matches the same file hashed independently AND CPU time per invocation stays well under the paid default of 30 s.
FAIL: exceededCpu / error 1102, an algorithm-negotiation protocol error, or a hash mismatch.
Either outcome is a valid result and must be written back into vps-file-hub's STATE.md before that feature proceeds.
evidence: mscdex/ssh2#1494 (open) - ssh2 fails at import under workerd
mscdex/ssh2#1401 - maintainer declines non-node socket API support
next: Create branch prototype/ssh-probe from main (predeclared as event e016), then build the minimal probe Worker and deploy it with the user-supplied VPS credentials.
